$comment: Platform capability evidence manifest (ADR-0001 §14, slice A0). Each capability maps the owner's 'evidence required' cell (ADR-0001 §1.1, verbatim) to its planned tests, fixtures and report artifact. An item is 'planned' until its slice lands; an 'implemented' item names the tests that prove it, which scripts/evidence/collect-pr-evidence.mjs looks up in a vitest JSON report (non-gating). The highest status this can yield is the statusCeiling; live verification is a signed evidence record in the owner's environment, never this file. SYNTHETIC fixtures only. Checked by scripts/evidence/platformEvidence.test.mjs.
statusCeiling: implemented and pre-release validated; live verification scheduled
